verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions a Vulkan backend, AMD GPU acceleration, or a way to run without ROCm. The generic `--gpu` offload flag on `lms load` does not establish Vulkan or AMD support. A community comment only wishes LM Studio 'played better with AMD hardware', which does not document the capability.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can accelerate inference on AMD GPUs via a Vulkan backend without needing a full ROCm install
